scope: The samples were transferred to a pre-chilled glass-glass conical Potter grinder (with good compliance between mortar and pestle) for tissue homogenization, on ice.

We added cold lysis buffer (8M Urea, 2M Thiourea (RPN6301; GE Healthcare Life Sciences), 50 mM DTT (Sigma; 646 583), 4% CHAPS 20 mM (GE Healthcare Life Sciences), Tris-HCl pH 8.5 plus protease inhibitors (Sigma, P8340) and homogenized the tissue by manual up-and-down strokes and minimize foaming.
Detergent was removed from the lysates and proteins were digested with Lys C and trypsin using the filter-aided sample preparation (FASP) protocol
